description.value: Mundo Novo Coffee Roasters bills itself as the first facility on Canada's West Coast to offer wholesale, private label, and co-op coffee roasting under a single roof. Founded by Cristina Dias, whose family has farmed coffee in Brazil since 1890, the operation also runs a coffee Education Centre offering training, cupping sessions, and lectures to culinary institutions and hospitality businesses across the Lower Mainland. The business is primarily trade-facing rather than a walk-in café.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, active business at 7037 Antrim Avenue, Burnaby (the OSM community tag says 'Vancouver' but the address is clearly Burnaby). The OSM name 'Mundo Nova' differs from the website's consistent 'Mundo Novo Coffee Roasters' — likely a typo in OSM. The website is entirely focused on wholesale, private label, co-op roasting, and coffee education for trade clients; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, retail takeout coffee) are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mundo Nova' but the website consistently uses 'Mundo Novo Coffee Roasters' — likely a typo in the OSM record.
OSM community is tagged as 'Vancouver' but the physical address and website both show Burnaby, BC.
OSM has no phone number; phone (604) 558.2470 is taken from website only.
Business appears to be primarily a wholesale/B2B coffee roaster rather than a retail café — walk-in retail availability for cyclists is unconfirmed.
Several website subpages contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text (e.g. education section body, brewing guides), suggesting the site may be partially under construction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational business with an active website and confirmed address. Primarily a trade/wholesale operation but publicly accessible for education and inquiries.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact phone confirmed from website footer only; not present in OSM tags. Address updated to include city and postal code as shown on website.

wow_evidence: first facility on Canada's West Coast to offer wholesale, private label, and co-op coffee roasting under a single roof
